scientific_choices.choice: One fixed version per method; no grid. Use frozen nearest backprojection to compare on identical components with historical methods. Bilinear experiments do not become defaults.

GROUP_COHERENCE uses V1 candidate edges sorted by gap/center-y/IDs; validates merged group vertical common overlap, centroid spread and height ratio with V1 limits. Small components below median height/V1 height ratio do not constrain the vertical core. If >=3 positive consecutive internal gaps, max gap must not exceed 1.5 times median of the remaining gaps; else no spacing gate.

PROBABILITY_CORRIDOR independently filters V1 edges. In the horizontal gap and shared vertical bbox interval require mean>=.2 and minimum column maximum>=.2. Overlapping/touching X boxes keep the V1 edge. Native probabilities are nearest projected to preserve binary input at .5. Not a learned affinity score; no probability map is fabricated from a prediction binary mask.

GT128 and GT_FULLRES use binary target values as support, explicitly not calibrated probabilities; foreground Don't Care handling remains unchanged. All word boxes/text used only after proposal generation.
Group-global gates and probability corridors are not paper-specified. Report geometry only, no Table5/OCR claim or baseline promotion.
